title: Global geometric Frobenius
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$, a
prime $\ell\neq p$. Write $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$, choose an algebraic closure
$\Qlb$ of $\Ql$, and choose a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$.
Let $Y_0$ be a separated finite-type
[def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $k_0$-scheme, put
$Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, set $\gamma=\operatorname{Frob}_q$, the geometric
Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], and
$g_Y=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma):Y\to Y$, and
choose $(K,\theta_K)\in D^b_{c,\mathrm W}(Y,E)$. The Weil structure
[def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] is the isomorphism formed with the derived
pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]
$Lg_Y^*\operatorname{For}(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{For}(K)$, and the
ordinary cohomology [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology] endomorphism is
induced by

$$
 \RGamma(Y,\operatorname{For}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}
 \RGamma(Y,Lg_Y^*\operatorname{For}K)
 \xrightarrow{\RGamma(\theta_K)}\RGamma(Y,\operatorname{For}K).
$$

The compactly supported endomorphism is the explicitly defined composite

$$
\RGammac(Y,\operatorname{For}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}
\RGammac(Y,Lg_Y^*\operatorname{For}K)
 \xrightarrow{\RGammac(\theta_K)}\RGammac(Y,\operatorname{For}K),
$$

where $s=\operatorname{Spec} k$ and
$\RGammac(Y,-)=\operatorname{Fib}_s(Ra_{Y!}(-))$. Both operators, and their
actions on cohomology [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology], are denoted
$F$.

In both composites the first arrow is the transport of cohomology along $g_Y$
[def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport], namely
$\tau_{\operatorname{For}K}$ for $\RGamma$ and $\tau_{c,\operatorname{For}K}$
for $\RGammac$; that these arrows are isomorphisms, as the symbol $\sim$
asserts, is [lem-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport-iso]. Here
$\operatorname{Fib}_s$ is the point fiber functor
[def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] and $Ra_{Y!}$ the compact-support direct
image [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], and the actions on
cohomology are $\mathrm H^i(F)$ on $H^i(Y,\operatorname{For}K)$ and on
$H_c^i(Y,\operatorname{For}K)$.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against its master blueprint source (identical) and against the slopmaster2 version (def:global-geometric-frobenius in 01_final_weil_conjectures.tex, which allows Lambda in {E, Qlbar} and takes the compact-support operator from the Weil structure on Ra_{Y!}K); no Lean exists on either branch. The six imported stmt_deps are all genuinely used (finite-field datum, separated finite type, g_Y, (K,theta_K) and For, Lg_Y^*, RGamma/RGamma_c and H^i/H^i_c) and were kept. Two symbols the statement writes explicitly were not named as dependencies and were added: Fib_s (def-weil-finite-coefficient-point) and Ra_{Y!} (def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed). The notion the statement hides is the unnamed isomorphism RGamma(Y,For K) -> RGamma(Y,Lg_Y^* For K) (and its compact-support twin), which no master node states (slopmaster2 names its compact-support half FrEx_{f,!} in def:weil-compact-support-object; def-exchange-projection does not apply to the Frobenius square since Y is not of finite type over k_0 and g_Y is not a k-morphism). It was created as def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport (point transport iota_N composed with the exchange map of the Cartesian Frobenius square, for all four coefficient rings), and the assertion '~' that it is an isomorphism as lem-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport-iso; one sentence was appended to the statement to name both, without changing its meaning. Both new nodes searched in Mathlib: only Scheme.EllAdicCohomology (pro-etale H^i(X,Z_l), no Frobenius, no compact supports) and the underived sheafPullback/Mates formalism exist; no match.
